header.title: Vortex
header.description: A spinning spiral over a card or image. `variant` sets the shape (`swirl`, `warp` or `ring`), `trigger` when it shows (on hover by default) and `intensity` how visible it is. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spiral stops spinning.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. With the default `trigger` (`hover`), hover over the card.

card.title: On a card
card.description: With the default `trigger` (`hover`), the spiral shows and spins while the pointer is over it. On leave it turns off. The root clips the layer, so it needs the same `border-radius` as the card.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `swirl` is a spiral of rays that fades toward the center, `warp` also twists the surface and `ring` concentrates the rays in a ring. Here with `trigger="always"` to see them side by side.

warp.title: Warp
warp.description: `warp` twists the surface (the child) on top of showing the spiral: it rotates `4°`, `8°` or `14°` depending on `intensity` and grows to `scale(1.03)`. Hover over each card. With `trigger="always"` the twist stays fixed. The twist transition uses the `--gemfx-duration-normal` token (`300ms`), and with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the surface doesn't twist.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `hover` turns on with the pointer or when you reach it by keyboard (visible focus on the root or inside), `click` toggles on each click and `always` spins nonstop.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the spiral opacity (`sm` 19%, `md` 30%, `lg` 44%) and, with `warp`, the twist angle. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long a full turn takes, in milliseconds. `delay` postpones the start of the spin.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` tints the rays. It takes any CSS color; `--gem-*` tokens are optional. Without the prop it uses `--gem-palette-primary-400`.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without adding a `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button` with `variant="warp"`: the layer is inserted inside the button and the button itself twists on hover.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the spiral where it is. `isDisabled` hides it and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onVortex` fires when the spiral turns on and `outVortex` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The inner button still gets clicks because the layer has `pointer-events: none`.

texts.body: Hover over the card and click the button.

header.title: Vortex API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Vortex`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/vortex` with its `vortex.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except color, and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.hidden: The spiral layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks on the content.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the spiral stops spinning, the warp surface doesn't twist and the layer stays at 35% while active.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the spin. Only use it if it's essential.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the spiral also shows on keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside), so it's visible while tabbing. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it on. onVortex only fires with the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click" the toggle listens to the root's click. If the child is a button (with asChild), it also responds to Enter and Space.
items.meaning: It's decoration: don't communicate state or information through the spiral alone.
items.vestibular: Spinning spirals can cause motion sickness. Prefer hover or click over always and avoid several continuous spirals in the same view.

items.root: Root. `position: relative`, `inline-flex`, `isolation: isolate` and `overflow: hidden` to clip the layer.
items.trigger: Active trigger. With `hover`, the layer is hidden while there's no `:hover` or `:focus-visible` (on the root or inside).
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the spiral animation.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the layer and removes the twist.
items.surface: Wraps the child. It's what twists with `warp`. With `asChild` it's the child itself.
items.layer: Absolute layer that overflows 20% on each side, clipped by the root.
items.swirl: The rays: a `repeating-conic-gradient` with `mix-blend-mode: overlay` and a radial mask that empties the center.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline on the root on every render, except `--gemfx-vortex-color`, which is only written when you pass `color`: without the prop, a class can override it.

items.duration: Length of one turn. Set by `duration`; default `4200ms`.
items.intensity: Intensity as a percentage. The spiral opacity is this value × `0.55`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Vortex reads as defaults.

items.intensity: Default for `--gemfx-vortex-intensity` before it's written inline.
items.durationNormal: Twist transition with `warp` (`300ms`), a bit slower than the base one.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content sits under the spiral and where the effect is mounted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Shape, intensity and color of the spiral.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Length of one turn and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows and how it's paused or turned off.

items.children: Card or image that sits under the spiral.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. The layer is inserted inside the child and, with `variant="warp"`, the child itself twists. With a void element (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the `div`, since the layer can't mount inside it.
items.intensity: Spiral opacity and, with `warp`, twist angle. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.color: Ray color. Any CSS color; `--gem-*` tokens are optional. Without a value it uses `--gem-palette-primary-400`.
items.duration: Length of a full turn. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `hover` with the pointer or keyboard focus, `click` toggles on each click, `always` spins nonstop.
items.isActive: Allows the effect. With `false` it turns off and `outVortex` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the spiral where it is.
items.isDisabled: Hides the layer and removes the twist; the child stays interactive. `outVortex` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Spins even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onVortex: Fires when the spiral turns on: on pointer enter, when toggled on by click, or on mount with `always`.
items.outVortex: Fires when it turns off: on pointer leave, when toggled off by click, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-vortex-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
